messages.en:
{07 14 00}I really appreciate
everything you did for me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma hindan väga kõike,
mida sa minu heaks tegid,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I'll never forget your
kindness!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}It's nice to know
you're there for me.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ma ei unusta kunagi su
lahkust!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Hea teada, et sa
oled minu jaoks olemas.

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I don't know
what I would have done if
you weren't here!
{07 14 00}So don't go moving on me,
because I don't want to
have to find out!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma ei tea,
mida ma oleksin teinud,
kui sind poleks olnud!
{07 14 00}Nii et ära koli minu juurest
ära, sest ma ei taha seda
teada saada!
